audit_scope: Read-only feasibility and research-design audit; zero models trained or retrained

planned_irrigation_start_times.finding: No planned start times exist in any dataset or raw export.

planned_irrigation_durations.finding: No planned durations or volume quotas exist.

recurring_schedules_or_timer_configs.finding: No timer configuration tables or automation logs exist.

farm_automation_calendar_entries.finding: No agronomic calendar or scheduled event entries exist.

actual_actuator_telemetry.source: Soil Moisture, Irrigation Actuator and Weather Dat/01_raw_data/raw_irrigation_actuators/raw_actuators.csv
actual_actuator_telemetry.nature: Historical realized valve state transitions (19.1% is_raw=True, 80.9% synthetic platform interpolation). Not an advance schedule.
actual_actuator_telemetry.forecast_origin_availability: Past entries (<= t) available; future entries (> t) unavailable.

reconstructed_irrigation_events.source: Soil Moisture, Irrigation Actuator and Weather Dat/02_processed_data/irrigation_events/final_irrigation_events.csv
reconstructed_irrigation_events.nature: Heuristically reconstructed events generated by 00_irrigation_actuators_cleaning.py. Post-hoc summary, not an advance schedule.

water_vol_to_24h.source: Soil Moisture, Irrigation Actuator and Weather Dat/02_processed_data/preprocessed/dataset_zone_{1..5}_preprocessed.csv
water_vol_to_24h.nature: Retrospective realized volume over rows t to t+143. Explicitly marked as leakage in DATA_DICTIONARY.md and README.md if used for live forecasting.

weather_forecasts_at_origin.nature: ERA5 atmospheric reanalysis (retrospectively assimilated global weather models), not historical numerical weather predictions (NWP) issued at time t.

task2_forecast_information_boundary.forecast_target: t + 24 hours (mean soil moisture over [t, t+144])

task3_phase19_selector_audit.inputs_used: 24-step historical sequence of irrigation_duration_minutes (rows i-23 to i)
task3_phase19_selector_audit.prediction_origin_alignment: Identical forecast origins and targets across all compared models

model_A_persistence.description: Current soil moisture predicted as 24h mean
model_A_persistence.expected_failure_mode: Severe error during wetting fronts (+10% to +25% moisture jumps)

model_B_existing_transformer.expected_failure_mode: Severe error during post-season quiescent dry periods (6.12% MAE)

model_C_future_schedule_conditioned.description: Transformer conditioned on explicit pre-published schedule vector
model_C_future_schedule_conditioned.expected_failure_mode: Cancelled/delayed schedules, flow rate anomalies, valve hardware failures

model_D_causal_hybrid.description: Regime gate using causal past water and/or pre-published schedule
model_D_causal_hybrid.expected_failure_mode: Under-prediction of unscheduled un-metered emergency waterings

task5_evaluation_protocol_design.partitioning: Chronological holdout with contiguous active irrigation cycles
task5_evaluation_protocol_design.current_dataset_test_split_limitation: The existing test split (late August to late September 2025) contains ZERO irrigation events. Evaluating schedule-conditioned forecasting on unseen test events is mathematically impossible with the current dataset partitions.
task5_evaluation_protocol_design.uncertainty_estimation: Cluster-block bootstrap by independent event/calendar day

decision_verdict.recommendation: GO for schedule-data collection and experiment protocol design; STRICT NO-GO for schedule-conditioned model training or production deployment.
missing_evidence: No pre-published planned schedule records exist in the current dataset.
No independent event-rich test period exists in the current split partitioning.
No flow-meter volumetric delivery pulses are recorded (only nominal binary valve timers).
Live ESP32 capacitive probes remain uncalibrated to soil volumetric water content.
decision_verdict.next_justified_step: Design field data-collection schema and firmware integration to record scheduled irrigation events alongside live telemetry, preserving production RF-11 classifier with PUMP_ALLOWED=False.
